headline: Murli Vasudevan, VP of Sales (After Market), resigns from Veedol Corporation
summary: Murli Vasudevan, Vice President of Sales (After Market) at Veedol Corporation Limited, has tendered his resignation. His departure is effective from the close of business on Thursday, December 24, 2026. The company officially informed the stock exchanges regarding this management change. Routine senior management departures have minimal impact on retail investors unless tied to broader operational shifts.
why_it_matters: Routine management exits rarely move stock prices.
